args.answer:
You may be a fit for either role, but I can’t confirm eligibility from the published information. The Animal Haven’s volunteer page says volunteers must be 21+, while its application form says 18+ (with 21+ only for dog walking), so your age of 19 needs confirmation. The same form states a one-year commitment; because you can commit for six months, that may be a barrier if it is still current. The current volunteer page redirects applicants to POINT, which couldn’t be checked, so those form requirements may have changed.

The cat-socializing role matches your interest in spending time with cats. Cleaning includes cat cages, but also dog runs and general shelter work; the form lists morning availability for cleaning. No specific openings or shifts are published. Ask Animal Haven whether the current age rule and commitment requirement allow you to volunteer for six months, and whether cat socializing is currently offered as a role.
